tasks.label: Run CI Checks
tasks.command: uv run isort --check-only --diff src/ && uv run black --check --line-length 127 --target-version py312 src/ && uv run flake8 src/ --count --select=E9,F63,F7,F82 --show-source --statistics

tasks.label: Parse Notebooks
tasks.command: uv run python -c "import json,glob; paths=sorted(glob.glob('notebooks/**/*.ipynb',recursive=True)); [json.load(open(p,encoding='utf-8')) for p in paths]; print('All notebooks OK' if paths else 'No notebooks found')"

tasks.label: Run All CI Checks
tasks.command: uv run isort --check-only --diff src/ && uv run black --check --line-length 127 --target-version py312 src/ && uv run flake8 src/ --count --select=E9,F63,F7,F82 --show-source --statistics && uv run python -c "import json,glob; [json.load(open(p,encoding='utf-8')) for p in glob.glob('notebooks/**/*.ipynb',recursive=True)]" && npx --yes markdownlint-cli2 "README.md" "docs/**/*.md"
